cases.case: Nonmonotonic sizes q4=1100,q3=800,q2=1000,q1=900; target1000 tolerance0
cases.expect: quality2 matched, no binary-search pruning

cases.case: Entire allowed quality range misses tolerance
cases.expect: unreachable only after exhaustive measured search; no output by default

cases.case: Attempt/time budget interrupts range
cases.expect: budget_exhausted, not infeasible; no output unless explicit best effort

cases.case: Metadata exceeds target at every quality
cases.expect: actual final-byte measurements include ICC/EXIF, preserve metadata, unreachable warning

cases.case: Cancel before/after encode and immediately before publication
cases.expect: no partial output; after atomic commit retain complete file and report committed

cases.case: Zero/negative/boolean/fractional/nonfinite target; tolerance>target; min>max; unknown keys
cases.expect: reject before render/queue admission

cases.case: PNG/TIFF/WebP or RGB16 request
cases.expect: unsupported, no dimension/format/depth substitution

cases.case: RGB8 already edited, cropped, watermarked; mutate live recipe during retries
cases.expect: one frozen image per output variant; every attempt identical pixels/options except quality

cases.case: GPS excluded/included; orientation from input; custom/source/sRGB ICC
cases.expect: same existing conversion/privacy behavior and output readback evidence

cases.case: Destination collision created between check and publish; symlink collision
cases.expect: never replace; skip or unique name; source remains byte-identical

cases.case: Marked and clean outputs differ in size; second variant fails
cases.expect: independent target receipts; existing partial-output receipts preserved

cases.case: Retry task after live controls changed
cases.expect: frozen target_size in task opts reused; restarted session cannot silently use current recipe

cases.case: MB versus MiB and exact tolerance edges
cases.expect: decimal vs binary explicit; inclusive ±B; no rounding to another target

cases.case: All encodes hit byte-buffer cap
cases.expect: encoded_budget_exhausted, never claim unreachable

cases.case: Nearest candidates tie
cases.expect: higher quality retained deterministically

cases.case: UI keyboard inputs invalid, format changes to TIFF, repeated export click during work
cases.expect: inline explanation, disabled while busy, no silent mode reset/conversion

cases.case: Encoder exception or corrupted JPEG/ICC/EXIF readback
cases.expect: failure with no published output; preserve original

cases.case: Disk full, unsupported hard links, directory fsync failure
cases.expect: no replace fallback; distinguish no output from committed but durability unconfirmed

cases.case: Change any target field after destination preview
cases.expect: Preview invalidated; preview and start normalize same policy and hash; stale plan rejected

cases.case: Frozen destination skip or new collision; missing authorized destination ancestor
cases.expect: Skip avoids encoding; raced target fails without rename; create_missing follows frozen policy

cases.case: Normal quality mode, virtual-copy IDs and layout PNG/PDF enabled
cases.expect: Legacy quality path preserved; target receipts identify each document and clean variant; layout output not mislabeled target-constrained

cases.case: Unreachable or partial watermark failure then task persistence/retry
cases.expect: Main error and persisted detail retain target receipt; successful variants preserved; frozen policy reused
